variantComments.preview: Dry run against LIVE mainnet: impersonates OWNER, signs nothing, broadcasts nothing, NEVER writes the progress file (preview CREATE addresses are fork-local fiction). It READS server/deployments/progress.stable-staker-v2-cutover.1.json when present. PREVIEW IS NOT THE POST-BROADCAST VERIFICATION (story 086, audit L-02): every phase is 'if (!done) do();' under an OWNER prank, so a step that never landed on mainnet is silently PERFORMED in the simulation and Phase 8 then asserts the simulated state (fork-proven: preview passes with V1's phUSD mint still live, with V2 still paused, with V1 registered and unpaused). Its two roles are the PRE-broadcast rehearsal and, AFTER stable-staker-v2-cutover:verify has passed, a smoke test of the live contracts. Smoke tests (prank only): the user-mandated Antimatter mint-revocation proof (throwaway minter approved -> mints -> revoked -> mint reverts; V2 revoked -> mint reverts -> re-approved), a 100-unit stake/withdraw on every V2 pool, and a 1000 DOLA stake + 10-minute warp + autoAnnihilate that must pay phUSD (a longer warp trips Tokemak's Chainlink staleness inside autoDOLA, not our wiring).
variantComments.broadcast: LIVE BROADCAST. Backs up mainnet-addresses.ts, runs the cutover on the Ledger, then the MANDATORY '&&' tail: patch-mainnet-addresses-stable-staker-v2.js FILLS the StableStakerV2 and Antimatter zero placeholders from the progress file (refuses unless deploymentStatus is completed; same-address is success so a resume leg is idempotent; key-set drift guard exit 3) then chains to :verify (story 086 - the read-only verifier that requires every phase's done-condition from live chain state and never performs a step) and only then to :preview as a smoke test of the live contracts. '&&' not ';' - patching after a failed forge run would write addresses that may not exist. --legacy --with-gas-price 0.3gwei and --gas-estimate-multiplier 200 are the story-071/073 lessons carried from promotion-ready (EIP-1559 maxFee dips below base fee in a long --slow Ledger session; per-block accrual makes depositFor cost more than the single-timestamp estimate); base fee was ~0.16 gwei at planning - re-check before signing. ~47 transactions (rehearsed end to end on an anvil mainnet fork). RESUME: the progress file is written in forge's LOCAL pass before sending, so after a crash it can name a contract that never landed - trim it to on-chain-confirmed deployments (run-latest.json receipts + cast nonce), keep the baselines block verbatim, run :preview, then re-run this key; every step is state-gated and the migration re-plans from live V1 state. The script aborts on any recorded address with no code. GLOBAL PAUSE (story 084, audit L-04): Phase 1 retires V1 in the order setPauser(OWNER) -> Pauser.unregister(V1) -> pause(), so V1 is UNREGISTERED from the global Pauser BEFORE it is paused and the permissionless EYE-burn Pauser.pause() stays live for the whole Ledger session (a registered V1 whose pauser is OWNER makes the pause loop revert 'StableStaker: only pauser' and pauses nothing). A HALTED RUN MUST BE RESUMED before the operator walks away - or OWNER must at least call Pauser.unregister(V1) - because a halt between V1's setPauser(OWNER) and the unregister leaves the breaker dead. Preview proves the breaker with a snapshot-isolated EYE-funded Pauser.pause() at three stages (GLOBAL_PAUSE|phase0, |after-phase1, |after-phase8 ... |SUCCEEDED); Phase 8 in both modes sweeps every Pauser registrant for unpaused + pauser == Pauser.
variantComments.verify: Story 086 (audit L-02) - READ-ONLY POST-BROADCAST VERIFIER (script/VerifyStableStakerV2Cutover.s.sol). No --broadcast, no --sender, no prank/deal/warp: it reads LIVE mainnet over RPC and never performs a step. For each cutover phase 1-7 it require()s the phase's done-condition from on-chain state - using the same done predicates as the cutover's own phase gates - and fails with 'verify: <phase>: <step> not on chain' naming the FIRST missing step (so before the cutover is broadcast it fails at Phase 1). The progress file supplies ONLY addresses (each must have code), the persisted phUSD minter baseline and baselines.cutoverStartBlock; its status field is never trusted. Checks: V1 retirement triple; V1 phUSD mint revoked; V2 + Antimatter pauser == Pauser and registered, V2 unpaused, claimEnabled false; Antimatter minter set exactly {V2} and the two-sided phUSD minter delta; per token V1 pool Migrating, live re-plan shows ZERO migratable V1 stakers (a V1 stake that raced the Phase-1 pause reverts naming the user, amount and remediation: re-grant the V1 phUSD mint, migrate them, revoke again), stragglers under the 1-cent cap, V2 pool configured, buffer recipient == V2, story 085's aggregate principal floor; per (token, user) every V1 MigratedOut with non-zero credit has a V2 DepositedFor within the strategy loss bound and V2 userInfo >= credited (logs via vm.eth_getLogs from the cutover start block in 5000-block windows; CUTOVER_START_BLOCK env overrides); then story 084's registrant sweep and the full Phase 8 wiring assertions. RUN IT IMMEDIATELY AFTER THE BROADCAST (the :broadcast key chains it): the floor and userInfo checks read live V2 balances, which later organic withdrawals can legitimately lower.
